products.title: Dojo Device Mount Generator
products.description:
## Description

Drag-and-drop this generator into your scene to quickly create 3D printable bracket to mount your device to any surface. Simply input the Dimensions of your object. 



## Features

- **Asset Type**: GeometryNodeTree
- **Blender Version**: 5.0.0+
- **File Size**: 0.68 MB
- **Catalog**: All Catalogs

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **Bracket Gen 4.5** from the Asset Browser onto any mesh object
2. The modifier panel exposes all parameters listed above
3. Set **Bracket Depth**, **Width**, and **Height** to match the device you're mounting
4. Adjust **Bracket Radius** and **Roundness** for corner style
5. Set **Wall Thickness** for structural strength (2mm default works for most prints)
6. **Bolt Radius** controls the mounting hole size
7. **Enclosure** adjusts how much the bracket wraps around the device
8. Toggle **Wings** to add/remove side flanges
9. Use **Label** to add embossed text to the bracket face

## Changelog

### Version 1.0.0
- Initial release
- Core functionality

## Support

For questions or issues with this asset, please contact The Well Tarot.

## License

Personal/non-commercial use only. Email joe@welltarot.com for commercial licensing or custom utility development.

products.title: Dojo Support Bracket
products.description:
## Description

An earlier version of the Bracket Generator -- a parametric bracket creator for mounting devices to surfaces. Generates 3D-printable brackets with adjustable reach, stretch, width, strut size, and bridge thickness.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **Dojo Bracket** from the Asset Browser into your scene
2. **reach** controls how far the bracket extends from the mounting surface
3. **stretch** adjusts the bracket's vertical span
4. **width** sets the bracket width (perpendicular to reach)
5. **strut** controls the thickness of the structural supports
6. **bridge thiccness** adjusts the thickness of the bridging element between struts

products.title: Threaded Insert
products.description:
## Description

A parametric threaded insert (heat-set insert) generator for 3D printed parts. Set the diameter and get three outputs: the insert geometry itself, a boolean cutter for creating clean pockets, and a combined view of both.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **Threaded Insert** from the Asset Browser into your scene
2. Set **Diameter** to match your heat-set insert size (e.g., M3 = 4.0mm, M4 = 5.0mm)
3. The modifier outputs three geometry channels:
   - **Insert** — the insert body (for visualization)
   - **Bool** — a boolean cutter shape (subtract from your part to create the pocket)
   - **All** — combined insert + boolean geometry

products.title: Dowel Shelf Generator
products.description:
## Description

A parametric shelf generator that creates dowel-joined shelving units entirely through geometry nodes. Set the overall width, depth, and height, choose how many shelves, and adjust the material thickness and dowel diameter. Toggle dimension annotations on or off.

Drop it in, dial in your dimensions, and export for 3D printing or use as a reference for a real woodworking project. The dowel joints are modeled as solid geometry — ready for boolean operations or direct STL export.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag the **Dowel Shelf Generator** object from the Asset Browser into your 3D scene
2. Set **Width**, **Depth**, and **Height** to define the overall shelf dimensions (gizmo-enabled for viewport dragging)
3. Adjust **shelf thiccness** for the thickness of each shelf panel
4. Set **Dowel Diameter** for the connecting dowel rod thickness
5. Change **no of shelves** to add or remove shelf levels
6. Toggle **dims** to show or hide dimension annotations in the viewport

products.title: Dojo Plywood Generator
products.description:
## Description

Procedural plywood cross-section effect applied through geometry nodes. Adds realistic layered plywood edge appearance to any mesh. Control grain rotation, texture scale, layer visibility, and whether side faces get the treatment too.

Originally built as "dojo_plyoood gn" for the Dojo Skaddis pegboard project — now extracted as a standalone utility for any box, shelf, or panel that needs that satisfying plywood edge look.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **Dojo Plywood Generator** from the Asset Browser into your Geometry Nodes editor
2. Connect your mesh to the **Geometry** input
3. Toggle **sides** to include or exclude side faces from the plywood effect
4. Adjust **rot** to rotate the grain direction of the plywood layers
5. Set **scale** to control the overall texture scale of the wood grain
6. Dial **layers** to control the visibility/density of the alternating plywood layers

products.title: Separate Half
products.description:
## Description

Split a mesh in half and get both halves as separate geometry outputs. Pick an axis, choose the direction, adjust the split factor, and select the domain (point, edge, face, etc). The Selection output gets the chosen half, the face output gets the other half, and the Result boolean can drive further logic.

This is the destructive sibling of Select Half Of Object — instead of just selecting, it actually separates the geometry into two streams.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **Separate Half** from the Asset Browser into your Geometry Nodes editor
2. Connect your mesh to the **Input**
3. Choose the split axis from the first **Menu** (x, y, or z)
4. Toggle **+/-** to flip which half goes to which output
5. Adjust **Factor** to move the split point (0.5 = midpoint)
6. Choose the separation domain from the second **Menu** (point, edge, face, etc.)
7. Wire the **Selection** and **face** outputs to separate geometry streams

## Changelog

### Version 1.0.0
- Initial library release (extracted from WIP nodes)
- 13-node geometry node group

## Support

For questions or issues with this asset, please contact The Well Tarot.

## License

Personal/non-commercial use only. Email joe@welltarot.com for commercial licensing or custom utility development.

products.title: Select By Bounding Face
products.description:
## Description

Select faces on a mesh by their proximity to a bounding box face. Feed in a geometry, pick which bounding face to target (by index), and dial in a distance threshold. The node outputs the geometry with the selection applied and a boolean result for downstream logic.

Great for quickly isolating the top, bottom, or side faces of any mesh based on its bounding box — no manual selection needed.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **Select By Bounding Face** from the Asset Browser into your Geometry Nodes editor
2. Connect your mesh to the **Geometry** input
3. Set **face select** to choose which bounding box face to target (0-5 maps to the six faces of the bounding box)
4. Adjust **dist** to control the distance threshold — faces within this distance of the chosen bounding face will be selected
5. Use the **face** output for the geometry with the selection applied, or the **Result** boolean for further logic

## Changelog

### Version 2.0.0
- Initial library release (extracted from WIP nodes)
- 11-node geometry node group

## Support

For questions or issues with this asset, please contact The Well Tarot.

## License

Personal/non-commercial use only. Email joe@welltarot.com for commercial licensing or custom utility development.

products.title: T-Slot Utilities
products.description:
## Description

A T-slot aluminum extrusion generator with a library of standard profiles (20x20, 20x40, etc.). Extrudes profiles along a mesh line with cost estimation, remeshing, and polygon size controls. Includes both the extrusion generator and a standalone profile library node group.

## Parameters

### T-slot Extrusion (mesh line)



### T-slot Profiles (standalone)



## Usage

1. Drag **T-slot Extrusion_mesh line** from the Asset Browser onto a mesh line in your scene
2. Select the extrusion **profile size** from the Menu dropdown (20x20, 20x40, etc.)
3. **poly size** controls the mesh polygon density of the extruded profile
4. Toggle **remesh** to apply a remesh for cleaner geometry
5. **Offset** repositions the extrusion relative to the mesh line
6. Enable **custom cost** and set **cost per mm** to estimate material costs
7. Toggle **disp cost** to display the cost value in the viewport
8. The **ext size** and **cost** outputs provide the extrusion dimensions and calculated cost

Alternatively, use **t-slot profiles** as a standalone node group to generate just the cross-section profile without extrusion along a path.

products.title: Dojo_Fillet by Length
products.description:
## Description

A curve fillet tool that rounds sharp corners on curves using a length-based radius, giving more predictable results than Blender's built-in fillet which uses a factor-based approach.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **dojo_fillet by length** from the Asset Browser into your Geometry Nodes editor
2. Connect **Curve** to the input curve with sharp corners you want to fillet
3. **radius** sets the fillet radius in scene units (e.g., millimeters)
4. **resample length** controls the point density of the filleted curve (smaller = smoother arcs)
5. Use the **Pt Select** panel to fillet only specific corner points:
   - Toggle **Only Selected Points** to limit the fillet to selected corners
   - **Corner Pt Select** picks a specific point index to fillet

## Changelog

### Version 1.0.0

- Core functionality

products.title: Chrome Crayon
products.description:
## Description

Chrome Crayon is a node-powered Blender utility that lets you turn simple hand-drawn curves into amazing cyber sigil 3D geometry. Effortlessly turn sketches into intricate, futuristic forms that are fully 3D printable--while also being light and fast enough to use in sophisticated digital art, animation, and motion graphics.

Harnessing the flexibility of geometry nodes, Chrome Crayon allows you to generate high-detail custom geometry with just a few clicks. Draw your curves directly in Blender or import vector paths, add the Chrome Crayon node group, and immediately see your designs transformed into clean, striking 3D meshes.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Draw a curve in Blender (Bezier, Pencil, or convert Grease Pencil/mesh edges to a curve)
2. Drag **Chrome Crayon** from the Asset Browser onto your curve object
3. **Line Thiccness** controls the stroke width
4. **Peak Height** sets the maximum extrusion height of the chrome ridges
5. **resolution** adjusts the mesh density of the generated stroke
6. **Sigilize** applies a sigil-style simplification to the curve (higher = more simplified)
7. **Soften** smooths sharp peaks in the chrome extrusion
8. Assign a **3D material** for the chrome shading in 3D mode
9. Toggle **FLATTEN** to collapse the stroke to a flat 2D plane
10. **Flat Color** sets the emission color when flattened
11. **Extrude Base** adds a solid base beneath the chrome stroke
12. **SPIRO** applies a spirograph transformation to the curve path
13. Toggle **Show Pt Count** or **crv preview** for debugging curve point info

## Changelog

### Version 4.3 (current) — Jan 2026
- **SPIRO** parameter: spirograph transformation applied directly to the curve path for generative pattern work
- **Extrude Base** with gizmo control: add a solid base beneath the chrome stroke for 3D printing and display
- **Show Pt Count** and **crv preview** debug toggles for inspecting curve point data
- Gizmo controls on Line Thiccness, Peak Height, and Extrude Base for direct 3D viewport editing
- Dual material slots: **3D material** for chrome shading + **Material** for flat/emission mode
- Bug fixes and improvements

### Version 4.0 — Dec 2025
- **FLATTEN** mode: collapse the chrome stroke to a flat 2D plane for motion graphics, laser cutting, or stylized renders
- **Flat Color** emission control for flattened output
- **Sigilize** parameter: apply sigil-style curve simplification at adjustable intensity
- **Soften** parameter: smooth sharp peaks in the chrome extrusion for cleaner results
- 2.5D workflow support — use the same node group for both volumetric 3D and flat 2D output

### Version 3.0
- Adjustable **resolution** for mesh density control
- **Peak Height** for controlling maximum chrome ridge extrusion
- **Line Thiccness** for variable stroke width
- Watertight, manifold mesh output for direct STL/OBJ export
- Optimized geometry nodes for fast viewport interaction and animation

### Version 1.0
- Initial release: core curve-to-cyber-sigil geometry node system
- Basic parametric chrome stroke generation from any Blender curve
- Cycles and Eevee compatible output

## Support

For questions or issues with this asset, please contact The Well Tarot.

## License

products.description:
## Description

This is a very sensible and reasonable solution for getting accurate measurements of meshes within the Blender work environment.

This is a fully functional 3D simulation of a digital caliper that measures with +/- .001 mm accuracy.

If any machinist, engineer, or rocket scientist ever questions you using a free Animation or Video Game Asset development software for serious CAD modeling tasks, just send them a screen recodring of you using this baby to measure your mesh models. That'll shut them up.

products.title: Dojo Bolt Gen v05
products.description:
## Description

Dojo Bolt Gen v05 is a flexible, procedural bolt generator for Blender designed to help makers and 3D artists create precise, customizable fasteners in minutes -- optimized for 3D printing as well as digital projects. With robust geometry nodes, this asset allows you to fine-tune every aspect -- thread profiles, head styles, shaft dimensions, chamfers, and more -- non-destructively, ensuring clean geometry suitable for physical fabrication.

## Parameters



## Usage

1. Drag **Dojo Bolt Gen v05** from the Asset Browser into your Geometry Nodes editor or onto a mesh object
2. Set **Type** to choose the bolt configuration (Bolt 3-Part Assembly, etc.)
3. Adjust **length**, **thread dia**, **head dia**, and **head height** to define the bolt dimensions -- all gizmo-enabled for interactive editing
4. **head sides** controls the polygon count of the bolt head (6 = hex, higher = rounder)
5. **a untapped** sets the unthreaded portion of the shaft
6. Toggle **TAP** to generate a matching tap hole for the bolt
7. **tap tolerance** adds clearance between bolt and tap for printable fit
8. Toggle **Print Ready** to optimize the output for 3D printing
9. Multiple output sockets provide different bolt configurations: full bolt, thread only, head sleeve only, split bolt for printing, and T-bolt
10. Use the **Filament/Cross Section Viewer** panel to preview print layers and cross-section the bolt for inspection

## Changelog

> **Community-driven changes:**
>The V1 cap design was difficult to fasten under load — so in v02 we flipped the split-to-print cap orientation from top-down to bottom-up, giving better mechanical advantage when tightening. Keep the feedback coming.

### Version 05.3 — Feb 2026
- Multiple output sockets (Bolt Output, BOLT GEO, TAP, Thread ONLY, Head Sleeve, Split Bolt, T-Bolt)
- Filament/Cross Section Viewer panel for print layer preview
- Gizmo controls on length, thread dia, head dia, head height, bolt-head offset, wall thickness
- Print Ready toggle for optimized 3D print output
- Send to origin toggle
- Extra panel: bolt-head offset + wall thickness controls
- Object version (Dojo Bolt Gen v05_Obj) available as separate drag-and-drop asset

### Version 05.2 — Nov 2025
- Bug fixes and improvements

### v05 — Aug 2025
- Torx bolt head research
- Thumb and key bolt variants added

### v04 — Jun–Jul 2025
- T-bolt feature: half T-bolt and adjustable T-bolt turn variants

### v03 — Mar 2025
- Major feature update to bolt generator
- Bug fixes and improvements

### v02 — Apr 2025
- Redesigned split-to-print cap orientation (cap flipped from top-down to bottom-up for better mechanical advantage) *(community feedback)*
- Added T-bolt printing mode: flat-bottom symmetrical bolt, no assembly needed

### v01 — May 2024
- First split-to-print feature (3-part assembly: 2 shaft halves + cap)
- Bolt Object integration with shelf assembly bracket generator

### V1 & V2 — Pre-2024
- Original parametric bolt generator with geometry nodes

## Support

For questions or issues with this asset, please contact The Well Tarot.

## License

Personal/non-commercial use only. Email joe@welltarot.com for commercial licensing or custom utility development.
